notes.title: Updated demo / Full one day
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32789182/7a4925a4f4fd0aba27245f43b8d7de4b03872138.png

Hello. Finally we updated the demo for you!

Now you can play a full one day in the demo. We also updated the menu and other little things.

As for the release of the game, this is the autumn of 2019. Wait for new news from us.

Wait for the updated demo at 6-8 pm GMT.
